name: New Castle Summer Day Camps (Tots Camp, Camp Adventure, On the Go)
operator_name: Town of New Castle Recreation & Parks
description_short: Town day camps for New Castle families: Tots Camp for ages 3 to 5 (half or full day) and the trip camp On the Go for grades 5 to 8, both at Westorchard Elementary in Chappaqua, and Camp Adventure for grades 1 to 4 at Amsterdam Park in Ossining, with art, swimming, sports, entertainers and theme days. Sold as a six week bundle or two three week sessions.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund within two weeks of registering, 50% between two and four weeks, none after that; medical requests go in writing to the Superintendent. Card convenience fees are not refunded.
notes: One posted rate. Tots Camp half day costs $1,250 for six weeks or $800 a session. Early bird discounts of $100 (six weeks) or $50 (one session). On the Go fee not posted.

for_andrew: Camp Adventure is for Town of New Castle residents and Chappaqua school district (CCSD) students; the Tots and On the Go pages do not say can enroll; nobody else. Andrew's rule for residents only camps: record the one rate, say who can enroll, and ask. List it?
One listing covers Tots Camp, Camp Adventure and On the Go, since they share dates. Camp Adventure meets at Amsterdam Park in Ossining, not in Chappaqua. Split it out?
